extraFields.label: District cooling (chiller) bill
extraFields.help: If your building’s air-conditioning comes from a district cooling company (for example Empower or Emicool), its monthly bill. This is separate from DEWA, ADDC or SEWA. Leave at 0 if cooling is included in your rent or comes from your own AC units.

single.note: Bill guides quote AED 500–2,000+ for district cooling; many units have cooling included, so the low end is 0.

suburban.note: Estimate; villas usually have their own AC units (0).

extraFields.label: Municipality housing fee
extraFields.help: In Dubai, renters pay a housing fee of 5% of the yearly rent, added to the DEWA bill in monthly instalments. Other emirates charge similar fees (Abu Dhabi’s is collected with the ADDC bill). Enter what you pay each month.

localTips.title: Offer fewer rent cheques for a lower rent
localTips.why: Rent is agreed per year and paid in 1–12 post-dated cheques. Landlords often take less if you pay in 1 or 2 cheques. Enter your rent here as the yearly amount divided by 12.
tips: Ask what the rent would be with 1 or 2 cheques instead of 4 or more.
Check the RERA rental index calculator before renewing: it shows whether your landlord can raise the rent.
Start looking 90 days before your contract ends; landlords must give 90 days’ notice of any increase.

pct.note: Judgement estimate of the discount for paying in fewer cheques.

localTips.title: Keep electricity out of the higher DEWA slabs
localTips.why: DEWA charges more per kWh as your monthly use moves through its slabs, so the summer AC months cost far more per unit.
tips: Set the AC to 24°C or higher and use timers so it isn’t cooling empty rooms.
Get the AC ducts and filters cleaned before summer.
Compare your monthly kWh on the DEWA app with the slab limits on your bill.

localTips.title: Cut Salik gates and use Nol for the commute
localTips.why: Each Salik crossing costs AED 6.30 at peak and 4.20 off-peak; four peak crossings a working day add up to over AED 500 a month.
tips: Check if a route without Salik gates adds only a few minutes.
Travel just before 6 am or after 8 pm when the toll is lower.
Try the Metro with a Nol card a few days a week and compare the cost.
